text: Historical382 moves Firefox/toolkit strings to Git while comm strings then still used Hg. Current code gets separate browser/mail revisions from l10n-changesets, clones Firefox and Thunderbird Git repositories, forces each revision^0, then copies scoped patterns. Bug context says command is outside CI but used by some downstream distributions. Source repository migration must preserve separate pins and output layout; no l10n build or clone executed in study.
title: Keep localized developer builds pinned to each repository revision
